purpose: Load the installed production-source Feishu plugin in an isolated no-network Shadow and verify account-scoped channels.start/stop through the real Shadow Gateway RPC.
allowed_operations: read-only installed OpenClaw 2026.7.1 and installed Feishu package origin/source audit
Shadow-only structured config and state under experiments/core_feishu_control_contract
read-only reference or junction to the installed Feishu plugin without modifying it
Shadow process-boundary fake transport with network-deny instrumentation
real Shadow Gateway RPC/CLI lifecycle checks on non-production loopback ports
compatibility-only update of the superseded 032 assertions to read their frozen report
prohibited_actions: modify production OpenClaw config, Binding, Agent, Cron, Gateway, zhongshu runtime, or PROJECT_STATUS.yaml
stop or restart production Core Feishu Binding or Gateway
connect to real Feishu or authenticate real RPC
use or print real App ID, App Secret, token, or complete config
install/download dependencies or repositories or use network
modify OpenClaw core or installed Feishu plugin business code
use a self-made empty plugin as Feishu proof
replace RPC lifecycle with direct internal function calls
run P0 Gate, R3/R4/R5, commit, push, or tag
secrets: Only fake markers, structural fields, counts, hashes, redacted paths, and statuses may be persisted.
